---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature, routing strategy, or provider integration for Nacho Flow
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

### 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature or capability you would like to see in Nacho Flow.

### 🌟 Problem & Motivation
What problem does this solve? How does it improve local GPU utilization, reduce cloud costs, or improve agent reliability?

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution / Implementation Idea
How do you envision this working? (e.g. new `expr` environment variable, new provider adapter, new normalizer filter, CLI flag).

### 🔄 Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions, workarounds, or features you've considered.

### 📚 Additional Context
Add any other context, benchmarks, or links to external specs/docs here.
